_instructions: Edit this file to control the button roles shown by the bot.
role_name must EXACTLY match an existing Discord server role.
id must be unique and should only use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
label is the text shown on the Discord button.
emoji can be a normal Unicode emoji.
style can be Primary, Secondary, Success, or Danger.
You may add more role objects. Discord allows up to 5 buttons per row; the bot automatically creates additional rows.
After changes: save this file, restart the bot, then run /post-panels.
